outcome: Umbilical cord blood Factor H concentration
cohort: Umbilical cord blood samples were collected from 12 term vaginal births, 12 term elective caesarean sections, 11 preterm births, and 14 cases of preeclampsia.
finding: Concentrations of C1q, C4, C3, and MBL in umbilical cord blood are lower in cases of preeclampsia and preterm births compared to term pregnancies.
mod_finding: In term pregnancies, MBL, factor H, and properdin concentrations were significantly lower in elective caesarean sections compared to vaginal deliveries.
cross-section timing: At birth, when umbilical cord blood samples were collected.
gest_age: The study included both preterm and term births, and within the preeclampsia group, complement factors correlated to gestational age, with early onset preeclampsia showing lower concentrations of C1q, factor H and properdin compared to late onset preeclampsia.
